## Appearance

Harcourt is a red-haired woman with sleek, glossy waves typically styled into a lengthy crimson plait. She features a small, pointed chin, a scandalously freckled nose, and a sweet mouth alongside notably large, luminous, and magnificent eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 ch.Life P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038), [v3 ch.Charming P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035)_

## Personality

Ann Harcourt is characterized by an extremely poor temper that she is required to learn to control. She also holds a strong belief in the holiness of obligations that she has undertaken.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P28](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0028)_

## History

Harcourt spent fourteen years living at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), a dwelling that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) imbued with illumination and vitality. On the eve of Nell's wedding, visitors gathered at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to celebrate, after which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) met Hugh on the eve of their ceremony. The following morning, friends and family gathered at the home to help prepare for the event. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) were subsequently married by Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md) in the sunlit orchard, after which the newlyweds departed for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), +2 more_

## Quotes

> "I could assist you so greatly at present and save you effort in numerous manners. For that single reason, I could truly desire to have been one."
>
> — Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "If I were traveling by car, I would bring you. However, I plan to go on foot, a distance too great for legs belonging to an eight-year-old. Furthermore, Cedric will accompany me, and I suspect his presence does not bring you pleasure."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)

> "Upon seeing him on the playground, he was so soaked that I dispatched him straight home to get dressed before I could learn the reason."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P6](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0006)

> "Emptiness is the absolute worst thing . . . and my departure from your existence is not happening. Letters and vacations do exist, after all. My dear, you appear somewhat pale and exhausted, I fear."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0033)

> "Belinda, it seems to me that Miss Rosalind requires a change of scenery. Her time spent here in solitude is far too great. Is there no way we can persuade her to take a short journey?"
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P46](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0046)

## Relationships

### [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harcourt--miss-pembroke.md)

[Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) is a friend of Harcourt, serving as a frequent visitor and favorite companion at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) since Volume 1.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

- Friend of — frequent visitor and favorite companion at Beechwood  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

### [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--harcourt.md)

[Belinda](../character/belinda.md) and Harcourt are close friends who reside in the same household. During outings and gatherings such as picking strawberries at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) confides her worries to Harcourt regarding Miss Rosalind's declining health and melancholic mood, and the two later share in the joy of romantic celebrations and wedding preparations together.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), +10 more_

- Friend of — close friends residing in the same household (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--harcourt.md)

Harcourt served as an instructor and mentor to [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), forming an immediate warm connection with him on her first day teaching in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) quickly became her favorite student, bringing her gifts of wild orchids, writing compositions for her class, and joining her on visits to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and discussions about local wedding arrangements.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), +14 more_

- Mentor of — former instructor to Cedric (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>
